list_child.name: lsBkg
list_child.desc: This tool lists every class booking currently on the gym's schedule, across all members and all class types. It is useful when you need a broad view of everything booked without filtering to one particular member.

get_child.name: getBkg
get_child.desc: This tool retrieves a single class booking record when given its id. It returns all details, including the class name, state, and session time associated with that booking.

list_parent.name: lsMbr
list_parent.desc: This tool lists every member enrolled at the gym, along with their basic contact information. It is the starting point for looking up which member a particular booking belongs to.

get_parent.name: getMbr
get_parent.desc: This tool fetches one member's full record using their member id. It is typically used after finding a member's id through the member listing tool.

delete_child.name: delBkg
delete_child.desc: This tool permanently deletes a class booking record from the schedule, and the action cannot be undone. It should only be used when a booking record needs to be wiped entirely rather than simply cancelled.

set_enum.name: setBkgState
set_enum.desc: This tool changes a class booking's state among booked, attended, no-show, or cancelled. Use it whenever the outcome of a scheduled class session needs to be recorded.

set_bool.name: flagWaitlist
set_bool.desc: This tool moves a class booking onto the waitlist rather than a confirmed spot in the class. It is typically used when a class has filled up and a member's booking needs to be bumped.

set_ref.name: moveMbr
set_ref.desc: This tool reassigns a class booking from one member's account to a different member's account entirely. Use it when a booking was logged under the wrong member and needs to move.

send.name: callMbr
send.desc: This tool places an outbound call to a gym member using the phone number on file. It is used to reach a member directly about a class booking or their account in general.
